<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Today every role is written by hand (the eight in community/roles/ were). This plan gives pij a small set of fresh, public templates and a way to start a role from one, while keeping C18's point that a community's roles come from its needs. Templates ship inside the daemon binary, as the pij/* schemas already do (crates/daemon/src/community/layout.rs:26-45), so a template needs no extra install and no launch. Every shipped version is kept, so the drift between the version a role came from and the current one can be shown exactly.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A prime can start any of the six common roles from a template in one command and edit it freely afterwards.
- A role made from an older template version shows what changed upstream, and nothing is applied without a person doing it.
- A new directory prompts for the core roles and for security without creating them, and says templates are examples (C18, C22).

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Auto-creating roles (ruled out by C22).
- The optional templates (devcontainer, researcher and so on): s10.
- The prime's wider prompts to spot uncovered needs (req-27 in full): s09 and s10. This plan only puts the 'templates are examples' wording into the s03 prompts.
- Assign and the view itself (s04, plan 195). The prompts here show inside s04's `pij directory`.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Code facts (2026-11-04, main 6ccd4d8): no templates/ directory exists; no role briefs in the repo. pij/role schema (.dd/schemas/pij/role/schema.json:43-208): meta has optional template, template_version and default_limit (:72-80); default_seat has harness, model, effort (:126-144); standing_packet is required, inline text or brief link (:162-182); changelog rows (date, by, why) are required (:184-208), and the writer stamps one (crates/daemon/src/community/role.rs:133-177). `directory add` maps flags to RoleFields (crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs:31-55, 128-150), builds via role::from_fields, which already writes template and template_version (role.rs:55-77), or reads --file; brief input today is --brief (role.rs:48-52, 115-123). Schemas are embedded with include_bytes! in crates/daemon/src/community/layout.rs:26-45. Rulings: C18 (templates are examples, not a checklist), C22 (core roles prompted, not created; security prompted until it exists; req-14 reworded). The wave B dogfood found the hand-written roles' 'instance of pm' has no pm template to point at yet; this plan supplies it.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| risk | likelihood | impact | mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Templates read like a checklist and communities copy them wholesale, against C18. | Medium | Medium | README and prompt wording (AC1, AC5); prompts list commands, never create; s09 adds needs-based prompts. |
| Template text leaks private or machine-local details from the hand-written roles it is modelled on. | Medium | High | Written fresh (req-13); security verdict on the exact head checks it. |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Templates are written fresh; never copy the hand-written roles' text, which mentions machine paths and this fleet's seats.
- Builds scoped with -p; check `df -h /System/Volumes/Data` first; stop and tell pm-001 under 25 GB.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`. No node_modules: TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- One push per review round; no pushes after a PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
